premise.coldViewerWhyCare: People are hearing that SR-15099 resets opioid tolerance; this explains the mouse research, control group and missing human evidence.
premise.earlyPayoff: The famous tolerance-reversal experiment actually tested related SR-17018, not SR-15099.

beats.narration: Can S R one-five-zero-nine-nine reset opioid tolerance? The famous experiment actually tested another chemical: S R one-seven-zero-one-eight.
beats.visualPurpose: Make the rumor a question, then separate the tested compound from the discussed compound.
beats.visualAction: Split the question into two chemically verified and separate identities, reserving SR-17018 for the actual evidence.

beats.narration: In mice, morphine sensitivity returned during a switch to S R one-seven-zero-one-eight, with withdrawal signs suppressed.
beats.visualPurpose: Present the intriguing result accurately as mouse study.
beats.visualAction: Show a qualitative mouse hot-plate response marker returning while a separate withdrawal marker diminishes, with illustrative labels.

beats.narration: Tolerance means the same amount has less effect with repeated use. Withdrawal means symptoms when an adapted body stops the drug.
beats.visualPurpose: Explain concepts in everyday language before comparing groups.
beats.visualAction: Physically separate response-strength animation from discontinuation-and-symptoms illustration. Clearly label conceptual diagrams, not measurements.

beats.narration: Here's the important detail: after three days without morphine, both the S R one-seven-zero-one-eight group and the control group regained sensitivity.
beats.visualPurpose: Make the control-group finding visually impossible to miss.
beats.visualAction: Two explicitly qualitative controlled tracks separate, advance over three days, and arrive at the same recovered morphine-sensitivity marker.

beats.narration: Withdrawal was suppressed in the replacement group, not the control group. A later mouse test found no reversal.
beats.onScreenText: A SECOND MOUSE TEST DID NOT REPLICATE REVERSAL
beats.visualPurpose: Separate the observed withdrawal effect from the failed transfer across assays.
beats.visualAction: Split the withdrawal signs, then transition into separate hot-plate and warm-water tail-response assay illustrations.

beats.narration: That is animal research, not proof that S R one-five-zero-nine-nine safely resets tolerance in people.
beats.visualPurpose: Close explicitly on the inference boundary and human safety uncertainty.
beats.visualAction: The study evidence frame remains attached to SR-17018, while a barrier prevents its transfer to SR-15099 as a proven human treatment.

beats.visualPurpose: Readable primary-source citation accessible after the narration.
beats.visualAction: Hold the canonical URL in a quiet source frame, no invented claims or animation.
